output.action_text: Upgrade `claude-code-action` to v1.0.72+ in workflows that use tag-trigger mode on PRs from external contributors. Pre-fix, untrusted PR content could expand the action's tool surface via prompt injection — see PR #1002 for the hardened permission model.
